config.deepdebris.title: Deep Debris
config.deepdebris.enabled.tooltip: Turns the alternate Ancient Debris texture on or off.
config.deepdebris.depth_threshold.toolti:
Ancient Debris in the Nether below this Y level uses the deep texture.
Blocks at this level and above stay vanilla.
config.deepdebris.texture_source.tooltip:
Default: Ancient Debris below the threshold uses the mod's own deep texture.
Custom: it uses the texture from the resource pack chosen below.
config.deepdebris.custom_pack.tooltip:
A pack from your resourcepacks folder that replaces the Ancient Debris texture.
It is read directly: it does not need to be enabled in the Resource Packs screen.
Changing it reloads resources.
config.deepdebris.missing_cloth.message:
Install Cloth Config to edit Deep Debris settings in game.
Until then the mod uses config/deepdebris/settings.json.
